text.en: Virtue and thought are the heart of Thirukkural.

This selection of kurals from Thirukkural speaks of virtue (அறம்) and thoughtful living. Thiruvalluvar says that a good life is built on goodness of mind.
The kurals are short, and each can guide our actions. Learn them with their meanings and use them in daily life.
Revise the chapter names, the meaning of each word, and the message. Remember that there are 1330 kurals in 133 chapters.
